iYali26 | Screened GPR candidate | SD-Leu / PO1f | 21 September 2026
Selected KO: YALI1D00581g (V1 D candidate) | Growth 1.87188 h-1 | KO/WT 100.0000%
R795: bounds [0,0]; already closed before knockout
All drawn WT fluxes = 0. Arrows show stored directionality, not positive flux.
Core view only: other proton-associated reactions and the wider ATP network are not drawn.
B. Test-only GPR shared by R794 and R795
AND across 12 shared candidates, then AND (a candidate 1 OR a candidate 2)
Native names unverified; homology / AlphaFold support, not experimental validation.
a-subunit OR is a test hypothesis, not demonstrated same-compartment complementation.
C. Why the screen does not change
Shared-component KO makes both pump GPRs false.
The complete saved WT flux remains feasible
The present constraints permit WT-level growth
ATP demand does not automatically require pump flux.
Biomass uses ATP; its reaction has no H+ [go]/[va] term.
D. What evidence is still missing?
and a supported mechanism linking it to growth.
Physiological direction and energy coupling of R1159.
A possible alternative connection; not an active WT bypass.
for the two a candidates under the same conditions.
Resolve the CLIB122 old-F / W29 locus conflict;
confirm an intact, expressed native protein.
Complete subunit stoichiometry and orthogonal evidence.
AlphaFold predictions alone do not validate function.
Do not add an arbitrary sink merely to force essentiality.
No new optimization or scientific model changes in this figure.
Evidence: 2026-09-21 screen + independent flux/GPR audit; prior sequence/AlphaFold review. Candidate status is retained.
